summary_en: ITOCHU completed a tender offer for treasury stock on September 1, 2026, acquiring shares at 1,813 yen per share over a 20-business-day period from August 4. The company will now conduct market purchases up to approximately 150 billion yen from the initial 300 billion yen authorization.
title_en: Notice Regarding Results of Tender Offer for Treasury Stock and Commencement of Market Purchase
translation_en_brief: ITOCHU Corporation announced on September 2, 2026, the completion of a tender offer for treasury stock and the initiation of market purchases. The tender offer period ran from August 4 to September 1, 2026 (20 business days), with an offer price of 1,813 yen per common share. The company had authorized a total acquisition budget of 300 billion yen. Following the completion of the tender offer, the company will proceed with market purchases of treasury stock limited to approximately 150 billion yen, representing the portion of the original authorization remaining after deducting the acquisition cost paid in the tender offer. Settlement of the tender offer purchases is scheduled to begin on September 28, 2026, with cash payment to be made net of applicable withholding taxes. The disclosure does not specify the number of shares acquired in the tender offer or the exact amount spent, stating only that the remaining authorization for market purchases is approximately 150 billion yen derived from the original 300 billion yen authorization.
